title: No Offhand Datapack
description: A Datapack That Deletes All Offhand Items
body:
**A Datapack That Deletes All Items In The Offhand Slot**

This datapack acts as a barrier towards dual-wielding in minecraft. It makes it so that any item put in the offhand is immediatly deleted. This is useful in an SMP or just as a singleplayer challenge.
